title: 记录表
summary: 记录表先问找、看、改落在哪一层。筛在这一列的表头，条件留在上方；表头钉在表自己的滚动区，名称列不能藏；一行只露出查看；有勾选，批量条才换掉搜索。
summaryEn: A record table first asks where find, see, and act live. Filter from the column and keep the conditions above; the header sticks in the table’s own scrollport and the name cannot hide; the row shows View; the bulk bar replaces search only after a selection.
asks: 找、看、改，分别落在记录表的哪一层？
asksEn: Where do find, see, and act live on a record table?

links.when: 筛选留下的是当前视图，记录还在；翻页会丢掉上一页
links.whenEn: a filter keeps the records and changes the view; paging drops the previous page

links.when: 勾选一直在，批量条等已选数量大于 0 才换掉搜索；不是长按才进入选择
links.whenEn: checkboxes stay put and the bulk bar replaces search only after a selection; this is not long-press to enter select mode

links.when: 筛到零条时，空白原因是条件，该改条件
links.whenEn: when the filter matches nothing, the blank is the condition — loosen it

links.when: 点金额换的是排序方向，不是把行拖成新顺序
links.whenEn: clicking the amount cycles sort direction; it does not drag the row into a new order

links.when: 一行是一条待跟进的记录，不是从指标往下钻
links.whenEn: a row is one record to follow up, not a metric you drill into
